nodes.check: every finding cites a source URL, and the digest returned to the COO is 15 lines or fewer
nodes.brief_given: the challenge, EXECUTOR_KINDS (agy is read-only, structured output)
nodes.intent: find how code graphs are generated today — the three tiers, the precision limits, stdlib feasibility — so the design rests on facts, not on one session's memory

stop.criteria: tiers 1-3 covered, each precision limit named, stdlib-ast feasibility stated; the digest written

nodes.returns: a findings file and a <=15-line digest

nodes.check: the spec names the node types, the edge types, the output schema, and the coverage query
nodes.brief_given: the challenge, n1's digest, and the unresolved decisions (location, format, coverage) with their provisional answers
nodes.intent: turn the research into a buildable spec: what nodes, what edges, what the CLI and JSON output look like, and how coverage is computed from the graph

stop.criteria: node types, edge types, output schema and coverage query all named; the spec is one file
stop.must_not_change: nothing; the design only writes its spec

nodes.check: code_graph.py runs on a fixture directory and emits valid JSON with nodes and edges
nodes.sabotage: remove a call from the fixture -> an edge disappears -> the check goes red
nodes.brief_given: the spec from n2 and the challenge, never n1's raw research
nodes.intent: build the stdlib-ast code_graph.py the spec describes

stop.criteria: the script runs on a fixture and emits valid JSON; the smoke check passes
stop.baseline: everything the baseline recorded as passing still passes

nodes.returns: the tool and a smoke-test result

loop.exit: a fresh node on a stronger tier with the check's output

nodes.check: the cases cover the algorithm's expected positive and negative cases, reported as a percentage
nodes.sabotage: a seeded mutant in the tool must be caught by the cases -> the check goes red otherwise
nodes.brief_given: the tool and the spec; the coverage rule (floor/target) with its provisional values
nodes.intent: generate the test cases — positive and negative — that the graph tool must be exercised against

stop.criteria: positive and negative cases written, each mapped to a node or edge, coverage % reported
stop.baseline: not applicable (no build in this node)

nodes.returns: the test cases with their coverage %

nodes.check: fixed checklist: every generated case passes or is an explained failure; the output matches the spec; findings cite file:line
nodes.brief_given: the tool, the spec, and the cases — never n3's or n4's reasoning
nodes.intent: an independent read: run the cases against the tool and report against the spec

stop.criteria: every checklist item answered with a finding or a clean pass
stop.baseline: everything the baseline recorded as passing still passes

nodes.returns: findings with file:line, or an explicit clean pass

nodes.check: the tool runs clean on this repo and its coverage summary matches a manual spot-check
nodes.sabotage: delete a known function -> its node disappears from the graph -> the check goes red
nodes.brief_given: the tool, the spec, and n5's findings — fix what the review found, then run it on this repo
nodes.intent: close the gaps the review found and prove the tool is complete by running it on this repository

stop.criteria: every n5 finding addressed; the tool runs clean here; the coverage summary matches a spot-check
stop.baseline: everything the baseline recorded as passing still passes

nodes.returns: the completed tool and its coverage summary over this repo

loop.exit: a fresh node on a stronger tier with the check's output
